prompts: Use case: precise-object-edit. Correct the character turnaround using ACTUAL FBX geometry, not generic claw-machine imagination. Image 1 is a factual 3x3 render contact sheet sampled from the user's actual claw model and animation: columns are front, side, oblique; top row CLOSED, middle row OPEN, bottom row CLOSED again. This image is the FINAL AUTHORITY for claw geometry. Image 2 is the character turnaround to edit; preserve character and art style but REPLACE all its wrong curved insect-like claw designs. Image 3 is the original character painting for color/style only. Actual claw: compact round hemispherical central metal hub with shallow circular rear flange. EXACTLY FOUR wide flat rectangular/tapered plate arms, at 90 degree spacing, forming a clear plus-shaped silhouette viewed along axis. Each arm has a straight broad proximal strut, a simple squared metallic hinge/collar at the outer elbow, and one long flat tapered distal plate. These are ANGULAR planar metal plates, not thin round rods, not curved pincers, not pointed talons, not propeller blades. In CLOSED state distal plates fold diagonally forward AND inward from the four outer elbow points toward the center axis, creating a four-sided angular cage/pyramid. In OPEN state the same distal plates swing outward/forward away from central axis as seen in middle row. Faithfully match widths, lengths, straight edges, simple construction and joints in contact sheet. Do not add ornamental bolts, tiny extra mechanisms, extra joints, cylinders, or organic curves. Recolor the factual neutral gray model into the original painting's olive-green plate arms with steel-silver hinge collars and dark gunmetal hemispherical center. Only surfacing changes; geometry follows model. Character attachment: preserve one olive square launcher box mounted on character's ANATOMICAL RIGHT SHOULDER harness, no neck/mask pipe, no waist equipment. Claw head connects rear central hub to the box's forward-facing steel cable outlet by a short tether, docked close to box in the CLOSED sampled pose. Scale is compact about head-width maximum, not giant foreground perspective. FRONT panel device viewer LEFT, front shows four broad plate arms around round hub in cross-like END-ON closed projection. SIDE panel character faces page RIGHT and displays same closed angular cage projecting forward toward page RIGHT. BACK panel device viewer RIGHT, mostly rear launcher/hub occludes forward claw cage, no sideways aiming claws. Keep identical orientation and geometry across views. Character body and suit, gas mask, straps, brown backpack, boots, gloves, orthographic poses and alignment, background and hand-painted comic shading stay unchanged. Bottom strip retain chainsaw on left, replace the old wrong grapple detail with TWO clear matching enlarged claw-head studies on right labelled CLOSED and OPEN, based directly on top and middle row of model renders, oblique view, FOUR countable flat angular arms, central hemisphere visible. Do not show claw-machine curved chrome arms anywhere. Complete polished landscape character turnaround; prioritize actual source-model fidelity over invented decorative detail.

Precise local image edit. IMAGE 1 is the current illustrated character sheet. IMAGE 2 is the actual FBX mesh sampled at the OPEN animation midpoint and is authoritative geometry. Change ONLY the bottom-right 'OPEN' claw study and the small claw on the BACK-view character; keep all other image areas exactly including CLOSED study, FRONT and SIDE figures, clothing, weapon and labels. OPEN STUDY: replace the diamond cage with a faithful painted reproduction of image 2's actual open geometry in the SAME camera angle as image 2. Round hemispherical gunmetal hub, four broad flat radial rectangular struts with squared hinge collars at their outer tips, four long straight tapered distal plates pivot OUTWARD/FORWARD at those collars. Distal plate endpoints are farther apart and do NOT meet inward, do NOT form a diamond, ring or closed cage. Match each of the FOUR arms in screenshot: upper arm extends upward then distal blade points right, right arm extends right then distal blade further right/down, lower arm extends down-left then distal blade down-right, fourth left arm remains separately visible behind toward lower-left. EXACTLY reproduce the screenshot's simple planar silhouette, flat polygon shape and open gaps, just recolor gray into olive green with steel collars and dark spherical hub, use same ink outlines/paint shading as sheet. No curved claw-machine pincers, no talon tips, no invented spokes. A small shoulder launcher box can remain behind hub but must not block four arm shapes. BACK VIEW shoulder at top-right: equipment on anatomical right (viewer right), launcher aimed into page toward character's front, so show compact rear face of square launcher and central rear circular hub with narrow four tips around perimeter; remove the sideways full-profile diamond cage currently projecting outward to the right. The claw axis must point forward in all views and rear silhouette must be compact consistent with FRONT end-on view. Preserve the entire rest of sheet. Full landscape output.

Tiny local edit to IMAGE 1: ONLY modify the claw attached to the MIDDLE SIDE-VIEW CHARACTER'S shoulder. It was mistakenly drawn OPEN whereas front/back depict CLOSED. Close this ONE shoulder claw to match actual FBX CLOSED silhouette in image 2 (side profile facing right). Four outer long flat plates pivot inward toward the forward central axis forming compact angular four-sided cage. Two visible upper/lower plates form the two sloped edges of a diamond in profile; center lateral plate ends near the nose. Metallic spherical hub remains left/rear, compact cable connector to shoulder box. Keep claw vertical extent no taller than head. No curves, retain angular flat olive plates and silver squared hinge collars. All other pixels/regions should stay unchanged: particularly preserve BOTH bottom CLOSED and OPEN detail illustrations exactly as they are; OPEN lower right must stay OPEN. Do not modify front/back characters, chainsaw, colors, text, poses or background. Middle shoulder must be CLOSED ONLY. Full landscape sheet.
